title: kbmon names no gate for a delivery refused for want of rights: PUSH_FAILED does not match it
goal: a delivery refused for want of rights shows that reason in the querylog panel's outcome and the alert, not 'no gate named' or an older line

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
H=tempfile.mkdtemp();E=dict(os.environ,CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA=H,CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=os.getcwd(),NO_COLOR='1')
q=os.path.join(H,'querylog');os.makedirs(q,exist_ok=True)
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import ql_deliver
say=ql_deliver.logged(q,out=lambda t:None)
def k(*a): return s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py',*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,timeout=120)
say('apply --push: pushed abc to origin/main');say('apply --push: the push was refused for want of rights (x)')
t=k('--json','--panel','querylog').stdout;print(t[-300:]);sys.exit(1 if 'no gate named' in t else 0)
